source: BerkeleyGW 4.0 Si-EPM GPP, fermi_level_absolute probe; see bgw/occupation_audit/REPORT.md

exported_records_vs_counted_events.note: the records are the first N qualifying evaluations encountered, not a random sample of the counted events

unmodeled_fields.vcoul: Coulomb factor; no internal relation in the record
unmodeled_fields.ieps: only constrained indirectly, through the omega2 residual
unmodeled_fields.e_lk: only its difference with e_n1kq is constrained, through wxt
unmodeled_fields.n1true: band index; only record-id integrity is checked
unmodeled_fields.occ_broadening: STORED DEFAULT, not evidence of smearing. Sigma/inread.f90:135 writes `sig%occ_broadening=0.1` with no kind suffix, so the default is the float32 image 0.10000000149011612. sig%do_smearing is a separate flag and is not exported; a nonzero value here does NOT mean smearing is on.
